data.one_liner: A widget to compare two stacked widgets by dragging a slider thumb.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that allows users to compare two stacked widgets by dragging a slider thumb horizontally or vertically. It reveals either side of the slider depending on the drag position.
use_when: You want to compare before-and-after images
You need a slider interface to reveal parts of stacked widgets
avoid_when: You are looking for complex state management or networking solutions
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical directions
Customizable divider, thumb size, and colors
weaknesses: Inner widgets expand by default unless wrapped in specific widgets like Center
